serverInfo.name: frugal
serverInfo.title: Frugal
serverInfo.description: The open routing layer for AI tools. Routes each agent tool call across providers per policy — cost (default), latency, pinning, deny lists — with automatic failover and the routing decision on every result. BYOK, no SaaS, no account.

streamable_http.note: Operators self-host: `frugal mcp serve --http :8765`. Bearer auth via FRUGAL_AUTH_TOKEN; rate limit + per-request timeout configurable.

install.notes: Single Go binary (~10 MB). Auto-detects Claude Desktop, Cursor, AnythingLLM, Claude Code and merges the MCP config in. No SaaS or account.

tools.name: frugal__execute
tools.description: Describe the job in plain language; Frugal classifies it onto a capability (URL / keyword heuristics, no model call) and routes it under the configured policy. Returns capability, provider_used, cost_usd, and a one-line reason.

tools.name: frugal__search
tools.description: Routed web search. The configured routing policy orders the chain (cheapest-first by default); falls through on errors and zero hits.

tools.name: frugal__extract
tools.description: Page → clean markdown/text/HTML. Local go-readability first, Firecrawl as paid fallback for JS-rendered pages.

tools.name: frugal__browse
tools.description: Headless JS rendering. Use when frugal__extract returns 'page likely requires JS'.
